title: slChannel: semi-Lagrangian DNS of turbulent channel flow on GPUs

creators.name: Cavallazzi, Giorgio Maria
creators.affiliation: City St. George's, University of London

description: A GPU direct-numerical-simulation solver for incompressible turbulent channel flow that replaces CFL-limited explicit advection with unconditionally stable second-order semi-Lagrangian advection along characteristics (Boukir et al. 1997, BDF2). The timestep is then limited by physical accuracy rather than by an advective CFL condition, giving a 2.65x reduction in wall-clock time per simulated time unit at matched turbulence statistics.
